phase: P1 eleventh increment: causal server-bar candidates and bounded fenced entry jobs; recoverable archive design
implemented: Explicit-policy causal candidate builder reuses server-owned closed 15m trend_structure. Symmetric breakout/pullback candidates, zero versus missing flow, exact threshold comparisons, no LLM/venue/sizing side effects.

Opportunity identity is stable across signal sources, builder/strategy versions and parameter changes for the same market/environment/symbol/side/closed-15m anchor. It does not identify an entire multi-bar trend.

Candidate assembly binds an externally sized TradePlan to exact policy, source digest, structure/time and execution safety evidence. Stored candidates or receipts must recover original facts, not reevaluate.
Independent database-only entry batch verifies current route and full account binding inside every business write transaction, before signal/intent/account locks. No exchange dispatch port.

Bounded cold-page discovery checkpoint survives disposable job restarts, wraps for late commits and advances only after confirmed discovery. Single-row hints, not append-only history or execution authority.
Direct spawn entry owner enforces absolute work/stop/terminate/kill budgets, rotates sources, retains unconfirmed child ownership and separates owner liveness from trading health.
Missing frozen inputs are visible typed waits; order-free UNKNOWN intents remain pending with reconciliation diagnostics/backoff; verified terminal intents are not falsely reported BLOCKED.
Dependency-aware archive design separates immutable content, permanent idempotency identity, FK/JSON dependencies, isolated restore proof and future cleanup. Design only; no live deletion.

qa.boundary: One temporary PG16/Redis harness at a time, Unix sockets, isolated conftest denies external TCP. No runtime configuration, exchange requests or runtime schema changes.

intermediate_runs.correction: QA route fixture tried BLOCKED/STOPPED with non-null worker token, violating existing schema constraints. Fixed fixture to reflect legal route state; no production constraints relaxed.
Test queried nonexistent v2_orders.side. Corrected assertion to join immutable intent.payload.side; both integration paths already reached PREPARED/dedup before that assertion.

intermediate_runs.scope: 31-file selected regression before strengthening two fault assertions
intermediate_runs.note: Subsequently strengthened real S3 progress after killed TV transaction and added committed-checkpoint response loss. Final rerun recorded separately.

covered_faults: Closed-minute/15m causality, gaps/future facts, zero versus missing taker flow, exact arithmetic under low ambient Decimal precision, symmetric thresholds and no breakout-buffer bypass.
Cross-source same-opportunity TV/S3 admission to one original intent and one PREPARED order for BUY and SELL, using synthetic closed server bars and isolated financial fixtures.
Route phase/epoch/account/token revocation before discovery and between admission/prepare; original identity resumes after permission restoration.
Business transaction role restored and route row lock retained until commit; cooperative stop rolls back uncommitted writes.

Direct child SIGTERM resistance and forced kill; backend transaction rollback proven by NOWAIT exclusive lock; TV receipt/intent absent; real S3 candidate for the same opportunity becomes sole winner and reaches PREPARED.
Committed financial work with lost IPC result reuses original intent/order/client IDs and exactly one PREPARED event; no SUBMIT.

Cursor survives disposable jobs and bounded scans wrap for late commits. Both pre-write checkpoint failure and committed-checkpoint acknowledgement loss preserve discoverability and independent hot work.
UNCHANGED terminal versus order-free UNKNOWN differentiation; unfrozen live signal stays DEFERRED without network context, new intent or false terminal.

static_checks.preexisting_format_note: A broader format check found an unrelated existing wrap in tests/v2_core/test_v2_trend_structure.py. That unmodified test file was preserved; all 11 changed Python files pass.

selected_regression.note: Final complete rerun of all 31 selected related test files after fault-case strengthening. Not all repository tests, a runtime process-group/venue lifecycle run, or evidence of strategy profitability.

remaining: Trusted candidate producer, actual account sizing/stop/leverage and first-writer freezing are not runtime wired. Data-object digests do not authenticate client inputs.

Controller combination of entry, management and settlement; DRAINING cancellation/audited expiry of unsent PREPARED must be independently implemented/tested. UNKNOWN/SUBMITTING cannot be treated as absent exposure.
Full same-episode dispatch, fill, protection, exit, fee/cash and settlement acceptance plus slow-dependency, account-switch and historical-scale tests.
No-candidate audited expiry and optional asynchronous model lifecycle.
Live retention reference-index application and million-row-scale verification remain separate; current disk growth is not claimed resolved.
Archive export/manifest/isolated restore tool and cold proof readers are not implemented. No historical data cleanup or guaranteed reclaim size.
P2 deterministic strategy-family comparison and prospective research window have not started; no profitability claim.

disk.note: Only isolated QA databases created for this turn were automatically removed after their processes stopped; diagnostics retained. Prior PG directory estimate ~109 GiB was not remeasured. This turn did not resolve live historical storage growth or claim reclaimable GB.
